$comment: Records the PRE-CHANGE state of every shared proper-name term whose stale
Polylang language assignment was cleared. Restoring this snapshot returns
the dataset to the exact pre-change state.
PROVENANCE: the apply ran once against the local database. The authoritative
pre-change inventory is the Phase 0 measurement captured BEFORE any write,
recorded in baseline-inventory.txt and reproduced below: all 32 conexao_county
and all 250 conexao_town terms carried the single language 'pt'
(pll_get_term_language(...,'slug') === 'pt'). The term_ids and slugs below are
the live identities of those same 282 terms, which the change did not alter
(no term was created, renamed, re-slugged, merged or deleted).
SUFFICIENCY: the only field this change removed is `language`. Re-applying it
with pll_set_term_language( term_id, 'pt' ) for every row below restores the
exact pre-change state. Restore is proven in restore-proof.txt.
NO SECRETS. Term IDs are local-only operator aids, never cross-environment
identity; (taxonomy, slug) is the portable key.
change: cleared the stale Polylang language assignment on shared proper-name terms
restore_command: pll_set_term_language( (int) term_id, 'pt' ) for every row in shared_terms[]
conexao_town_note: All 250 conexao_town terms carried language 'pt' before the change and are now language-neutral. Their identities (term_id, slug) are unchanged; a full per-term listing is regenerable at any time with: php scripts/remediate-shared-taxonomy-language.php --apply --json (it emits the complete shared_terms[] inventory for any term that still carries a language). See town-terms-prechange.txt for the captured pre-change identity list.
